verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs repeatedly emphasize pay-per-token, no idle GPU time, no minimums, no hidden fees, and low pay-as-you-go pricing with no long-term contracts, implying transparent self-serve pricing rather than sales-gated pricing. However, the evidence pack contains no direct citation of an actual public pricing table listing per-token rates for each hosted model, so we can't confirm exact per-model price visibility. Missing for 10: a direct reference to the pricing page/table showing per-token prices for individual models, and confirmation that all models (not just a subset) are listed without sales contact.
